message:
You know that moment when you finally get around to packing those go-bags we’ve been talking about for ages? Well, we had a little storm yesterday that turned out to be more than just a drizzle. As we huddled inside, I felt an odd mix of relief and that smug ‘I told you so’ feeling when I saw our bags packed and ready. 

It was a gentle reminder that being prepared isn’t about being paranoid; it’s about peace of mind. So, here’s to those little actions we take today that might just make tomorrow a bit smoother. Have you had any ‘I told you so’ moments lately? 😊
